name: neuro-vision
description: Base open-source de visao computacional: a webcam enxerga e registra o que ve.

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:server && npm run build:client && npm run build:workers
scripts.build:workers: esbuild public/perception/workers/worker-onnx.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=public/workers/worker-onnx.js --external:https://* && esbuild public/perception/workers/worker-pose.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=public/workers/worker-pose.js --external:https://* && esbuild public/perception/workers/worker-maos.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=public/workers/worker-maos.js --external:https://*
scripts.dev:workers: esbuild public/perception/workers/worker-onnx.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=public/workers/worker-onnx.js --external:https://* --watch & esbuild public/perception/workers/worker-pose.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=public/workers/worker-pose.js --external:https://* --watch & esbuild public/perception/workers/worker-maos.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=public/workers/worker-maos.js --external:https://* --watch
